title: E-commerce Customer Details
summary: Customer detail page with left sidebar showing customer avatar, name, customer ID, and detail fields (email, phone, status, etc.) plus an 'Upgrade to Premium' CTA card. Main content area has tab navigation (Overview, Security, Billing, Notifications) showing account balance card, loyalty program card with progress, addresses section, and an orders placed data table with status chips and payment method icons.

layout.columns: Left sidebar (~30%) with customer profile card and upgrade CTA, main content (~70%) with tabs and detail sections
